In this week’s Motivational Monday Minute, Chaplain (Lt. Col.) Corwin L. Smith, Acting Command Chaplain for the District of Columbia National Guard, reminds us that positive change doesn’t come simply from what we learn — it comes from what we consistently choose to do with that knowledge.

The lesson is simple: Learn. Choose. Act. Repeat. Growth isn’t a single decision. It’s what we choose to do consistently every day. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Master Sgt. Arthur M. Wright)

Nimitz is underway in the U.S. 2nd Fleet area of responsibility in order to complete the ship’s Precision Approach Landing Systems (PALS) certification, maintaining operational success and readiness. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Octavio Borrego; Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Recruit Hunter Kelley)

carriers.title: The Backbone Behind the Mission: ADP Keeps TR Connected
carriers.description: Aboard USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN 71), nearly every Sailor depends on computers, networks, and digital systems to carry out daily operations. The Automated Data processing (ADP) division is responsible for delivering and maintaining the technology that enables the crew to communicate, coordinate, and execute the mission.

carriers.title: Lead With a Purpose
carriers.description: For a Sailor who began her career as an undesignated Seaman, survived combat and cancer, and rose to senior enlisted leadership aboard an aircraft carrier, Command Master Chief Jackey Smith’s legacy continues to unfold. And the measure of that legacy is clear: ensuring the Sailors who deploy together return home together.
